purpose: Continue the offline three-session walk-forward program after terminal Campaign064 by selecting at most one genuinely independent mechanism from frozen definitions and source schemas before any Campaign065 value is opened.

schema_only_source_boundary.raw_minute_source: Tushare licensed one-minute snapshot already present under the frozen historical minute root

candidate_design_catalog.reason: It measures the arrow of local volatility-state evolution by contrasting the forward 13-state weak-order distribution with its exact time-reversed distribution. Entropy, state frequencies without reversal, return cubic moments, price direction, and magnitude are not the target mechanism.

Campaign064 already measures normalized entropy of the same 13-state range-triple alphabet. Campaign065 must be invariant to changes in entropy that preserve reversal-pair balance and must react to reversal-pair imbalance even at comparable entropy.
Campaign039 already uses an antisymmetric cubic contrast of adjacent signed close returns. The selected concept uses no close, signed return, magnitude-weighted moment, or cubic normalization.
Those choices introduce state-boundary, lag, conditioning, smoothing, and estimator searches. One exact marginal forward-versus-reverse weak-order distribution is selected.

Interval overlap, frontier, boundary translation, and revisit geometry are already represented in the complete terminal library; the selected concept discards price levels and retains only the ordering of log high-low widths.
Activity conditioning would overlap existing amount-volatility, range-volume, price-discovery, and lead-lag mechanisms and would add weighting and threshold degrees of freedom.
A single symmetric Jensen-Shannon divergence divided by ln(2) is selected for finite support, symmetry, zero-safe semantics, and an exact [0,1] range.
Both complete halves, 118 triples per half, tuple length three, higher direction, no cross-lunch transition, no filter, and no combination are fixed once.

selected_concept.mechanism: Transform every fixed one-minute bar to log high-low range, classify all within-half overlapping triples into the exact 13 transitive weak-order states, construct the state distribution induced by reversing every triple, and measure their normalized Jensen-Shannon divergence.
selected_concept.economic_question: Does a pronounced time arrow in the evolution of intraday volatility states identify unresolved information assimilation that can persist from the next open through the third close?
known_design_risks: The new score shares the high-low range transform and 13-state alphabet with Campaign064 and therefore must pass the frozen strict-below-0.8 numerical comparison against Campaign064 after coverage passes.
Exact ties can concentrate mass in self-reversing states; ties must be retained and zero divergence is valid rather than missing.
Divergence family, normalization, tuple length, pooling, direction, time grid, and missing rules create researcher degrees of freedom unless frozen before values.
The current-listing-derived source and holding universes retain the documented survivorship limitation.

decision.next_action: Perform one exhaustive all-96 definition mechanism-overlap audit, including the Campaign063 nonnumeric challenge and Campaign064 as the final numeric comparator, then freeze one exact formula before opening source values.
